purpose: Brief closed-eyelid overlays for the existing retro-v5 expression sprites.

integration.render_mode: Keep the original expression sheet visible, overlay the blink sheet at identical dimensions/background position, and clip to the eye region.
integration.reason: Image editing regenerated small areas outside the eyelids; an eye-only overlay avoids silhouette or clothing flicker.

assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: attached existing 1536 x 768 pixel transparent sprite sheet with 3 exactly equal 512 x 768 cells showing the same male office-worker character in normal, worried, and happy expressions.
Create the BLINK-CLOSED animation frame for this existing sprite sheet. Change ONLY the eyelids of all three characters: both eyes completely and gently closed for an ordinary relaxed blink. Use thin curved closed-eyelid lines. Not smiling eyes, not a squint, not sleep. Preserve each original brow and each original mouth expression.
CRITICAL INVARIANTS: exact same canvas 1536 x 768, same 3 columns, exact pixel alignment of every head, eye socket, hair, body, shoulders, shirt, tie, lanyard and every other detail. Same matte retro cel animation rendering and original skin color. Same head angle and face shape, same hair silhouette, identical bust positions. Do not recenter or zoom any person. No new objects, no text, no labels.
Keep the transparent background and original alpha silhouette. This is a two-frame blink animation so changing any pixels outside the small two-eye areas will make the animation jump. Preserve those pixels.
assets.inspected: All six eyelids are gently closed. Original mouth expressions, brow directions, warm skin, pose, and outfit are visually retained.
assets.caveat: Use as a clipped eye overlay, not a full-sheet swap. Source sheet face positions vary slightly by expression.
